from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0047.png").convert("RGB"))

# Let find the brown face of the cabinet:
# The brown face is on the right side of the white front face (u > 330)
for u in range(330, 350):
    col = img[300:430, u, :]
    # brown mask: R > 150, G ~ 120-160, B ~ 80-120
    brown_rows = np.where((col[:, 0] > 150) & (col[:, 1] > 100) & (col[:, 1] < 180) & (col[:, 2] < 140))[0] + 300
    if len(brown_rows) > 0:
        print(f"Brown at u={u}: v in [{brown_rows.min()}, {brown_rows.max()}]")
'
